teaser: What does it cost you to hold a room together while also running it? You are a 2, the Peacemaker, built on sensing what others need before they ask, and an ESTJ, the Executive, built to set the terms of the room itself. Most readings of the 2 picture someone soft at the edges; most readings of the Executive picture someone who draws the line and holds it. In you, the softness and the line share a desk. You keep the peace by making sure everyone already knows the rules, and you keep order by noticing who flinched when you said them.
excerpt: A folded blanket waits by the rooftop door at dusk, brought up because the evening will cool and someone will want it.
